notes: index.html already carries three legacy JSON-LD blocks. Remove them when injecting these, or the page ends up with two Organization nodes.

The legacy Organization block states addressLocality 'Bengaluru'. Every address source in the repo (Footer.jsx 'Thane · Mumbai · Maharashtra', Menu.jsx 'Est. 2019 · Thane', contact/CtPage.jsx HQ block) says Thane. Bengaluru is listed in CtPage.jsx only as a satellite team. This file uses Thane.
The legacy WebSite block declares a SearchAction whose target is tools.html, which is not a search endpoint. That SearchAction is fabricated and is not reproduced here.
foundingDate 2019 from Footer.jsx 'Quietly outperforming, since 2019.' and Menu.jsx 'Est. 2019 · Thane'. numberOfEmployees 28 from careers/CrPage.jsx '28 people'.

omitted: AboutPage subtype not used: spec asked for a WebPage node.
Organization.founder / employee / member: about/*.jsx names no individual people.
Organization node not repeated here, it is referenced by @id from the homepage node.

ItemList of the 12 brands in work/WorkGrid.jsx: only one of them resolves to a real page (Brand Handbook.html). The rest link to Our Work.html#slug anchors, so listing them as ListItems would publish URLs that do not exist.

The per-brand result tags (ROAS, revenue, traffic figures) are not restated as structured data. They are marketing copy on the page with no schema.org property that fits, and restating them as machine-readable claims is exactly what the no-invented-results rule guards against.
aggregateRating / review: none published.
datePublished / dateModified: no publication date anywhere on the page or in handbook/*.jsx. 'Q4 2024 – Q1 2026' in HbHero.jsx is the engagement window, not a publish date.
author as a Person: no byline on the page, so author falls back to the Organization.
wordCount / timeRequired: not stated.

The four hero figures (11.8× blended ROAS D90, 78% D90 retention, ₹24.6Cr net revenue over 12mo, +587% YoY) are carried in 'abstract' because schema.org has no property for standalone result figures. They are quoted from handbook/HbHero.jsx, not computed or extrapolated.

JobPosting nodes for each role: JobPosting needs datePosted and validThrough, and neither exists anywhere in careers/CrPage.jsx or job/JdPage.jsx. Emitting them without a date would be inventing the field, so each ListItem carries name and url only.
baseSalary: only job/JdPage.jsx carries a band, and only for some roles. Left out rather than emitted for a subset.
Department, location, workMode and employment type per role are in CrPage.jsx but have no home on a bare ListItem, and belong on the JobPosting that cannot be dated.
notes: careers/CrPage.jsx defines 8 roles and renders {roles.length}, so the live page shows 8. The baked prerender in Careers.html and the meta description still say '6 open roles'. This file follows the source array (8). Worth reconciling the copy.

telephone and addressLocality come from Footer.jsx (tel:+917666309102, 'Thane · Mumbai · Maharashtra'). Street, postcode and hours come from contact/CtPage.jsx. The +919619472727 contactPoint is the WhatsApp number from the same file.

not_covered: home-classic.html and home-v1.html: both are Disallow'd in robots.txt as duplicate homepage variants, so structured data on them would only compete with index.html.

tools.html, the 6 calculators and d2c-marketing-glossary.html: these already ship BreadcrumbList plus WebApplication / DefinedTermSet / FAQPage. Untouched. They could later be pointed at the shared Organization @id, which they currently are not.
source_conflicts_found: Brand count: index.html meta description says '24 brands', Our Work.html and Menu.jsx say '14 brands'. Neither number is emitted as structured data. The homepage WebPage.description quotes its own meta verbatim, so it carries the 24 as-is.
Open roles: careers/CrPage.jsx defines 8 roles and renders {roles.length}. The baked prerender in Careers.html and the Careers meta description still say 6. The ItemList follows the source array (8).

Locality: the legacy Organization block in index.html says Bengaluru. Footer.jsx, Menu.jsx and contact/CtPage.jsx all say Thane. This file uses Thane and treats Bengaluru as a satellite team, which is how CtPage.jsx describes it.
Our Work.html links a client to Brand Handbook.html, but the handbook itself is DeoBar Skin Co. The Article node describes DeoBar, which is what the page actually contains.
injection_notes: Each value is an array of complete, standalone JSON-LD objects, each with its own @context. Emit one <script type="application/ld+json"> per object, or wrap the array in a single script tag. Both parse.
Nodes are cross-linked by @id, so the order within each array does not matter.
Do not hand-edit inside the <!--prerender--> markers. These belong in <head>, above or beside the existing meta tags.
site_wide_omissions: aggregateRating, reviewCount, review: no ratings or reviews are published anywhere in the repo.
Offer, price, priceRange, priceSpecification: no pricing is published anywhere.
SearchAction: no search endpoint exists. tools/Glossary.jsx filters client side with no query URL.
founder, employee, Person nodes: the repo names no individuals.
datePublished / dateModified: no page in scope carries a publication or revision date.
